data.one_liner: Flutter widgets for executing GraphQL operations using the ferry client
data.what_it_does: Provides thin wrapper widgets around Flutter's StreamBuilder to execute GraphQL operations using the Ferry client. It helps display GraphQL query, mutation, and subscription results inside the widget tree.
use_when: You are using the Ferry GraphQL client in a Flutter app
You want declarative StreamBuilder wrappers for executing GraphQL operations
avoid_when: You prefer direct use of StreamBuilder without wrapper widgets
You are not using Ferry for your GraphQL client
strengths: Simplifies integrating Ferry operations into the Flutter widget tree
Built as thin wrappers around standard StreamBuilders
weaknesses: Widgets may not be strictly necessary to work with ferry in Flutter
Limited documentation outside of basic widget wrappers
